preview.qualification: display-only; samples are not a global error bound or landmark qualification
preview.recipe: exact point weld; VTK quadric decimation with volume preservation; no registration/rescaling

definition_sources.role: Anatomical feature definitions only; no numerical osteometry or image reproduction

landmarks.label: Anterior superior iliac spine
landmarks.definition: Anterior end of the left iliac crest, where it forms the anterior superior iliac spine.
landmarks.review_rule: Review the original cortical surface in multiple views; record the selected tip and the local crest patch. A coordinate extremum alone cannot identify it.

landmarks.label: Posterior superior iliac spine
landmarks.definition: Posterior end of the left iliac crest, where it forms the posterior superior iliac spine.
landmarks.review_rule: Distinguish the posterior superior spine from the posterior inferior spine and sacral surface. Review the original crest patch.

landmarks.label: Pubic tubercle
landmarks.definition: Raised feature on the superior portion of the left pubic body near the medial end of the superior pubic ramus.
landmarks.review_rule: Review the small feature on the original surface; define the selected apex and distinguish the pubic crest and symphyseal face.

landmarks.label: Ischial tuberosity
landmarks.definition: Roughened prominence on the inferior portion of the left ischium.
landmarks.review_rule: This is a broad region rather than a unique point. Review and record a surface patch and an explicit point selection rule before acceptance; do not use the lowest bounding-box point by default.

landmarks.label: Sacral promontory
landmarks.definition: Anterior lip of the superior sacral base forming the posterior part of the pelvic brim.
landmarks.review_rule: Review the anterior superior rim on the original sacrum and define a midline point using a reviewed median-plane construction. Resolve the source lumbar-6 context before any spinal interface adoption.

go_criteria: Two independent reviewers identify the same anatomical features on the pinned original surface and record original node, primitive, face or patch, vertex indices and native coordinates.
A reviewer establishes a metric calibration argument and segmentation limitations for this exact original. glTF meter encoding alone is not metric qualification.
SYSOP approves point or patch definitions and a fit-for-purpose numerical error budget before any acceptance or registration.

Any later rigid registration uses at least four reviewed noncoplanar correspondences, records conditioning and residuals against the approved budget, and leaves SOPHY 1.0.0 unchanged until a separately reviewed embodiment decision.
stop_criteria: Unresolvable feature or insufficient original segmentation
Unknown metric fidelity or disagreement exceeding the approved budget
Mapping lumbar-6 into the five-lumbar canon without review
Treating draft points, sampled decimation error or an exterior skin surface as qualified osteometry
nasa_role: Use the existing PHY NASA positioning/range catalog for posture, measurement-frame and operating-condition comparison. It cannot locate these bone features, supply missing osteometry, or establish mechanical limits or NASA compliance.
